subjective_results.rationale: Every required label is fully visible and readable on both final renders, with no observed clipping or collisions.
The much larger central Inspect block establishes focus while smaller side blocks preserve the sequence; the fixed label font limits the sense of a complete object zoom.
No named PowerPoint version or captured Slide Show playback was available.

limitations: Morph XML and endpoint images do not establish PowerPoint playback or its interpolation.
The fixed-font backend grows the Inspect carrier but does not enlarge the Inspect label font between slides.
Text labels export as native text-bearing rectangle shapes, not formal txBox=1 textboxes. The strict frozen criterion remains failed.
Native text/shape presence is structural editability evidence only; real PowerPoint editing is unobserved.
Unsupported viewers may use the declared fade fallback, whose timing need not match the Morph duration.
Bitstream Charter is the renderer-selected font; target-system font substitution was not tested.
